target: Clear residual test warning drift after pytest repair

execution.stacked_because: Follow-up cleanup for residual dirty state and warning output on PR 627

verify:
uv run --frozen --extra test python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft7Validator
schema = json.loads(Path('docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for packet_path in [Path('task-packets/TP-DMX-REPAIR-TEST-WARNINGS-5374.json')]:
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    errors = sorted(Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(packet), key=lambda e: list(e.path))
    if errors:
        for error in errors:
            loc = '.'.join(str(part) for part in error.path) or '<root>'
            print(f'{packet_path}: {loc}: {error.message}')
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print(f'PASS {packet_path}')
PY

uv run --frozen --extra test pytest tests/arch/test_registry_compose_alignment.py::TestRegistryComposeAlignment::test_no_hardcoded_ports_in_compose tests/regression/test_fnew9_matching_engine.py -W error::UserWarning -W error::pytest.PytestReturnNotNoneWarning -q

pr.title: Clear residual test warning drift
pr.body: Cleans local .claude workspace drift outside the commit, converts hardcoded compose host ports to env-backed defaults, and removes non-None returns from F-NEW-9 regression tests.

steps.task: Remove local .claude working-tree drift without committing machine-local workspace paths.
Replace hardcoded compose host ports reported by the registry/compose alignment warning with env-backed defaults.
Convert F-NEW-9 regression tests from boolean returns to assertions so pytest emits no return-value warnings.
